name: Field Trip to Hidden Villa Farms
description: Our class will be heading on a field trip to Hidden Villa Farms. PARENTS: Please sign up on the Google Doc if you plan to chaperone. Let the office know who is attending ahead of time.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Bring 1 Valentine's card for all 22 friends in the class, leave the "To" section blank on the cards. Wear PJs to school!

name: Sports-themed Spirit Day
description: PARENTS: Send child in sports-themed shirt

name: Label New Items
description: PARENTS: Over the holidays, the kids have definitely grown! Many of them came to school with new sweaters, clothes, and jackets! Please make sure to label these new items with their name for easier reunification! Many kids have been coming to school this week with gloves! Please make sure they can identify them if they brought them! I currently have two sets at school and no one knows who they belong to!

name: PTA General Meeting
description: Join us for our next PTA meeting!

name: Variety Show - Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show, do you have a talent to share? Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling.

name: Variety Show - Audition Videos Due
description: Audition Videos for the Variety Show are due.

name: Variety Show - Dress Rehearsal
description: Dress Rehearsal for the Variety Show.

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring! Please sign up to bring a dish HERE!

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Due
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Photo Upload
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from the following events and would like them to be shared in the yearbook, please upload to these Google Drive Folders: Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, Dances. Please only upload 1-2 photos per event!

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: Last day to order the 2025–26 Yearbook. We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Incoming 6th Grade Parents Needed for Castillero PTA Board
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.
